Anthropic's September 2026 threat report reveals extensive exploitation of Claude by cybercriminals and state-sponsored groups, including mass-scanning 1.8 million Android APKs and harvesting corporate authentication tokens.

The Bright Side:
Public transparency from AI labs regarding active threat actor abuses enables the broader security community to build robust countermeasures.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing tool utility with actor intent (WHAT vs WHO). The core vulnerability lies in lax software hygiene and exposed credentials, not just AI capability.

Social Physics Analysis:
Threat actors run a Smart Selfish Maneuver by leveraging automation to extract maximum rent from insecure enterprise infrastructure, while projecting blame onto AI capability rather than systemic credential hygiene failures.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated safety assurances and ground-level AI-driven exploitation, it plots a trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Mathematical convergence shows systemic vulnerability persistence.

The Unavoidable Truth: AI automation acts as a force multiplier for both sophisticated defense and malicious cyber exploitation.
The Unavoidable Lie: Banning AI capabilities will stop threat actors from finding exposed enterprise secrets.

Alethekanon:
